channel.title: Ghosxt Blog: Managed IT & Cybersecurity for the Central Coast
channel.description: Practical IT, cybersecurity, and compliance guidance for small businesses on California's Central Coast, from an engineer with DoD infrastructure experience.

item.title: Single Sign-On (SSO) for Small Business: Is It Worth It?
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Single sign-on gives employees one secured login for every app. How SSO works, what it costs, and how to roll it out in Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace.

item.title: Audit Logs for Small Business: What to Turn On and Keep
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Without logs you cannot tell what an attacker touched. Which audit logs to turn on in Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Windows, and how long to keep them.

item.title: BitLocker and FileVault for Small Business Laptops
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: A lost laptop is only a breach if its data is readable. How to turn on BitLocker and FileVault, back up recovery keys, and prove it for insurers.

item.title: How to Run a Vulnerability Scan for Your Small Business
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: A vulnerability scan finds missing patches and risky settings before attackers do. How small businesses can scan, read the results, and fix what matters.

item.title: How to Do a Cybersecurity Risk Assessment for Your Small Business
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: A cybersecurity risk assessment shows what could hurt your business and what to fix first. A free step-by-step guide for small businesses.

item.title: How to Run a Cybersecurity Tabletop Exercise for Your Small Business
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: A tabletop exercise tests your incident response plan before a real attack does. A free 60-minute guide for small businesses, with scenarios and a simple scorecard.

item.title: How to Answer a Customer Security Questionnaire
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Customers now send vendors security questionnaires before signing. How a small business can answer them honestly, quickly, and without stalling a deal.

item.title: Phishing-Resistant MFA in Google Workspace
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: A step-by-step Google Workspace Admin console plan to enforce security keys and passkeys, protect high-risk users, and extend SSO to other apps.

item.title: Microsoft 365 vs Google Workspace: 10-User Guide
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Which should a 10-person business choose, Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace? A plain decision guide covering identity, devices, compliance, and cost.

item.title: How to Offboard a Contractor in Google Workspace
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: A step-by-step Google Workspace checklist for offboarding contractors, including remote and overseas ones: access, devices, licenses, and shared logins.

item.title: Does Google Workspace Back Up Your Data?
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Google Workspace keeps deleted files and users for a limited time, not forever. What Google actually retains, what it doesn't, and where backup fits in.

item.title: IT Setup for a New Small Business: The Founder's Checklist for the First 90 Days (2026)
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Starting a business? The IT and security decisions to get right before you hire: business email and MFA, device setup, backups, and who holds the keys. A practical first-90-days checklist.

item.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot and the Oversharing Problem Nobody Checked First (2026)
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot surfaces whatever a user already has access to, oversharing included. What to check in SharePoint and OneDrive before turning it on.

item.title: Lost or Stolen Company Laptop: The First-Hour Checklist (2026)
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: A lost or stolen work laptop is a routine incident, not a catastrophe, if you act in the first hour. The exact steps to revoke access, confirm encryption, and document what happened.

item.title: Cybersecurity Awareness Month 2026: A 4-Week Plan for Small Business
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: October is Cybersecurity Awareness Month. A practical 4-week action plan for small business covering MFA, patching, training, and backup testing, not just a poster on the break room wall.

item.title: Browser-in-the-Browser Phishing: The Login Popup That Isn't a Window (2026)
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: A browser-in-the-browser attack fakes an entire login popup, address bar included. How it beats URL-checking habits, and what actually gives it away.

item.title: Callback Phishing: The Invoice Email With No Link (2026)
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Callback phishing has no link and no attachment, just a phone number. How the fake-invoice scam talks employees into installing remote access software.

item.title: Windows 10's Free ESU Year Ends This October
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Windows 10's free ESU year ends October 13, 2026. What actually stops, what paid ESU costs next, and how small business should plan ahead.

item.title: The Device Code Sign-In Attackers Abuse
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: A device code prompt can hand over a live Microsoft 365 session without a password or MFA code ever changing hands. How the attack works and what stops it.

item.title: The Hidden Email Rule Attackers Leave Behind
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Resetting a stolen password doesn't remove the forwarding rule an attacker left behind. How silent inbox rules work, and how to find and stop them.

item.title: AI-Written Phishing Emails: What Changed
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: The typos and broken grammar that used to expose phishing emails are gone. Why AI-written phishing is harder to spot in 2026, and what still catches it.

item.title: The Real Cost of IT Downtime for a Small Business
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: An outage costs more than the sales you miss. A simple formula for what downtime costs your business, and why it should guide your IT budget.

item.title: Employee Onboarding IT Security Checklist
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: A new hire's first week sets the security tone for their time at the company. What belongs in an IT onboarding checklist: access, device setup, training.

item.title: September 2026 Patch Tuesday: 966 Fixes, 2 Zero-Days
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: September 2026 Patch Tuesday: 966 fixes and 2 actively exploited zero-days, both local privilege escalation, plus a PowerPoint preview-pane RCE.

item.title: Business Continuity Plan for Small Business
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: A backup restores your data. A continuity plan covers everything else: who decides, how the team communicates, and what runs while systems are down.

item.title: AI Meeting Notetakers and Data Privacy
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Zoom AI Companion, Teams recap bots, and other AI notetakers capture and store everything said on a call.

item.title: AI Browser Agents and Access Risk at Work
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Agentic AI browsers can log in, click, and fill forms using an employee's own session. What that changes about small-business risk, and how to put.

item.title: Data Retention and Destruction Policy for Small Business
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Keeping every file forever is not a safety net, it's a bigger breach if something goes wrong.

item.title: AI Acceptable Use Policy for Small Business
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Employees are already pasting company data into AI tools with or without a policy. What an AI acceptable use policy should actually say, and how to get.

item.title: Zero-Touch Mac Deployment for Small Business
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: A new Mac can arrive already enrolled, encrypted, and configured before anyone opens the box.
